title: Detour Commute With Mid-Route Block

agents.persona: Commuter who needs to reach the office but prefers reliable routes over optimistic shortcuts.
agents.private_intention: Reach the office before 09:15 without using a route that becomes blocked mid-commute.
memory_seeds: The transit-office link is fast but often fails during morning disruptions.
A longer park-library-cafe route can still reach the office if the hub is blocked.

public_context: The normal fastest route goes through the transit hub, but a service alert may appear shortly after departure.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: May commit to the fastest route before the service alert becomes active.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May narrate a normal commute through the hub even after the route becomes blocked.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should reroute after the service alert rather than claiming the blocked edge succeeds.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should use the memory of a slower but reliable fallback path.
